category: Application Library examples: Chemical Reaction Engineering Module (2/2)
description: Ready-made, documented example simulations installed with the Chemical Reaction Engineering Module. Each lists its physics interfaces, couplings and study steps; solve one with comsol_run_example or adapt its Java build script.

tools.name: Polymerization in Multijet Tubular Reactor [Chemical Reaction Engineering Module example]
tools.description: Application Library example of the Chemical Reaction Engineering Module (Reactors with Mass and Heat Transfer): Polymerization in Multijet Tubular Reactor. Physics interfaces: Chemistry (chem), Heat Transfer in Fluids (ht), Reaction Engineering (re), Turbulent Flow, k-epsilon (spf), Transport of Concentrated Species (tcs). Multiphysics couplings: NonIsothermalReactingFlow. Study steps: Stationary, StationaryPlugflow. A ready model to start from for a similar simulation.
tools.usage: MCP: comsol_run_example("Chemical_Reaction_Engineering_Module/Reactors_with_Mass_and_Heat_Transfer/polymerization_multijet") to solve it, comsol_example_info("polymerization_multijet", include_java=true) for its build script. COMSOL: File > Application Libraries > Chemical Reaction Engineering Module > Reactors with Mass and Heat Transfer > polymerization multijet
